items.title: Adding Rex
items.answer: Press **Add Rex** on the home page (or in the Dashboard), pick your server and accept. You need the *Manage Server* permission there.

items.title: Settings
items.answer: Open the **Dashboard**, pick your server and use the side menu. Changes reach the bot within a couple of seconds. You can also use `/settings` in Discord.

items.title: Not seeing my server
items.answer: Servers only show if you have *Manage Server* there and Rex is inside it. Add Rex first, then press refresh on the Dashboard. If it still isn't there, log out and back in.

items.title: Premium codes
items.answer: Open **Premium** on the website or your server's Premium page, paste the code and press Redeem. Codes are one use per server unless it says otherwise. If it says invalid, check for typos and that it hasn't expired.

items.title: What Premium gives
items.answer: **Premium** adds AutoMod, multiple ticket types, anti-ping roles and the command builder. **Priority** adds faster support and priority features. **Ultra** adds your own bot name, picture and banner. See the **Premium** page for the full list.

items.title: Free trial
items.answer: Joining our support server for the first time gives your account a **7 day Premium trial**. Check your DMs for the button to activate it on a server.

items.title: Tickets
items.answer: Set tickets up under **Tickets** on your server dashboard: pick a channel, add ticket types and press save. The panel in Discord updates by itself. If a button does nothing, make sure Rex can see and send in that channel.

items.title: Ban appeals
items.answer: If Rex DM'd you after a ban, press **Appeal Ban** in that message. Each server decides how many appeals you can send. If you didn't get a DM, contact that server's staff directly, we can't unban for other servers.

items.title: Rex offline
items.answer: Check the **Live stats** page. If Rex shows online but a command fails, make sure it has permission to see and send in that channel. Maintenance is shown on the Live stats page too.

items.title: Permissions
items.answer: Rex needs *View Channel* and *Send Messages* where it works, and its role must sit **above** the roles it manages. Run `/botperms` for a check.

items.title: AutoMod
items.answer: AutoMod lives under **Protection & AutoMod** (Premium). It uses Discord's own AutoMod, so it keeps working even if Rex restarts.

items.title: Custom commands
items.answer: Open your server, then **Commands** in the side menu. Build commands and events from blocks, no code needed. Premium gets 5 commands and 5 events, Priority and Ultra get unlimited.

items.title: Levels and XP
items.answer: Levels are under **Levels & XP**. Turn them on, pick a channel for level-up messages and (optionally) role rewards.

items.title: Welcome messages
items.answer: Go to **Welcome & Leave** on your server dashboard. Use `{user}` for the member and `{server}` for the server name.

items.title: Delete my data
items.answer: Open your **Profile** and use the delete option. That removes what the website stores about you.

items.title: Bug report
items.answer: Thanks for telling us! Could you describe what you pressed and what happened? If you'd like, I can bring in a real person to take a look.

items.title: Thanks
items.answer: You're welcome! Anything else I can help with? 💙
